_comment: Levonis Print Cloud workshop agent — copy to agent.config.json (chmod 600), edit, run: node tools/print-cloud-agent/agent.mjs --config agent.config.json --check. Keys starting with _ are comments. Full reference: docs/PRINT_CLOUD_AGENT.md

cloud._token: The agent token (pca_...) is shown ONCE when an admin creates the agent. It is read from this environment variable and never from this file.

_state_dir: A directory only this agent uses: boot counter, job records, print files. Back it up as a whole; never restore state.json alone.

jobs._start_mode: auto: upload and start an assigned job; manual: upload it and wait for someone to start it on the machine
jobs._bed_clear: operator: after a print ends, the next one starts only after `--bed-cleared <connection_ref>`; assume_clear: for machines that clear their own bed

_printers: Keyed by the connection_ref the cloud stores for each printer (admin: PATCH /api/admin/print-cloud/catalog/printers/:id {adapter: 'agent', agent_id, connection_ref}). Addresses and credentials below never leave the LAN.

lan-x2d-1._tls: The printer certificate is self-signed. pin = its SHA-256 fingerprint (get it with --print-fingerprint 192.168.1.50:8883); ca = ca_file + servername; insecure = no verification, logged as a warning at every connection.

lan-sim-1._comment: A simulated printer for a dry run against the real cloud: bind a test printer to this connection_ref.

_slicer: Optional. Only with the token's `slicer` capability. Profiles must be complete exports (OrcaSlicer/Bambu Studio JSON without an inherits chain; PrusaSlicer .ini).
